synopsis: Drama 01 ENG is a fictional narrative set in the English-speaking world, exploring characters and events from Old English to Middle English periods. It features key figures like Beowulf and Geoffrey Chaucer, highlighting the development of vernacular literature.
setting: The setting spans from the Anglo-Saxon period (5th century) to the Middle English period (1470s), with a focus on England during the Norman Conquest in 1066 and the rise of London as a literary center.

Beowulf.description: A legendary hero from Old English literature.

Geoffrey Chaucer.description: A significant figure in the development of Middle English vernacular literature.
